brief: MEPZ Run 2027 (11th edition) eco running event redesign; content preserved verbatim from mepzrun.in; navy #1D4E9E / leaf green #5DB82E / amber #F5A524 brand; premium, purposeful motion with reduced-motion fallbacks. Iteration 2: cinematic green hero (oversized bleeding MEPZ RUN type, AI-generated runner cut-out with blurred motion trail and controlled RGB glitch, green gradient light) followed by a scroll-scrubbed 15s running film that expands to full bleed, a scroll-velocity slogan band and a scroll word-reveal statement. All copy reused verbatim from existing content.

completionGate.rule: readyForImplementation only permits building; it never means finished. Install, import, mount, run a production build and observe each selected effect in a browser. An HTML entry file is normal in React, but a handwritten HTML/CSS substitute is not.
perComponent: installed package version or component file

commandPolicy: Commands are indexed provider metadata, not executed here. Run only in the inspected target project after reviewing registry source and resolving blockers. Inspect actual installed paths/exports; preserve provider notices.
sequence: First resolve elementPlan: content, hierarchy, placement, alignment, responsive behavior and motion for each element within each necessary section. Register multiple component entries per section when needed; do not force one effect onto an entire section.
Save this contract as .motion-studio/build-plan.json. Present the chosen stack and section-to-component mapping briefly; do not pause for routine creative approvals.

Inspect package.json, lockfile, source entry points and framework config. For a new unconstrained project using React Bits, choose React; use the existing framework for established projects unless migration is authorized. Do not edit generated dist files as source.

Resolve blockers. Inspect official source, choose exact language/style variants, check shared dependencies and configure registry prerequisites. Install the selected components into the target project.
Confirm installed exports, actual import paths and supported props. Update integration evidence and call this tool again until readyForImplementation is true.

Implement the listed section files and mount the actual selected components. Implement the specified triggers, animated properties, states, timing and transitions. Do not replace them silently with CSS fades.
For 3D, resolve the real model or procedural geometry, materials, camera and interaction plan with get_3d_build_plan. A photo of a car does not count as a 3D model.
Run the real project build and inspect the running site. Verify each planned component is imported AND rendered, animation responds to its trigger, and its visual effect matches the intent.

Check full scroll journey, reverse scroll, touch, reduced motion and hero/CTA clipping. Record actual screenshots or recordings and results in .motion-studio/build-report.json. A plan or successful installation alone is not completion.
completionEvidence: Each section: planned recipe, installed file, importing module, rendered instance and observed animation
Desktop and mobile viewport checks including CTA visibility
Unimplemented or substituted items with reasons; never label these complete
limitation: This is an enforceable data/schema workflow inside the tool, not model training. External coding agents must follow it; the MCP cannot independently guarantee their execution or visual quality.
